A loop where nothing goes to waste

Every stage is designed so that nothing from the brewery ends up in landfill. Tap the stages to explore the flow.

  1. Production generates spent grain, surplus yeast, trub, wastewater treatment sludge and other residues.

  2. Scheduled collection at the plant gate, with volume tracking for every load and full environmental paperwork.

  3. Our technology stabilises, preserves and sorts each fraction towards its highest value destination.

  4. Treated spent grain becomes a protein and fibre rich feed for beef and dairy cattle.

  5. Organic fractions become compost that returns organic matter and nutrients to the soil.

  6. By-products find new agricultural and industrial uses, cutting disposal.

  7. Healthier soil and well fed herds close the loop that grows grain again.

Proprietary technology that turns waste into product

A process refined over decades of operating alongside major breweries. It controls the variables that degrade the waste and prepares each fraction for the right destination.

Discover the technology

  1. 01

    Collection and tracking

    Scheduled pickup at the plant, logging volume, origin and time for every load.

  2. 02

    Stabilisation

    Moisture, temperature and microbial activity control to preserve the material for longer.

  3. 03

    Sorting and conversion

    Each fraction goes to animal nutrition, composting or new products, according to its properties.

  4. 04

    Delivery and reporting

    Delivery to the final destination plus a report with volumes, destinations and environmental indicators.

Results for the brewery

  • Reuse first, with less waste sent to landfill
  • Environmental indicators per batch, ready for ESG reporting
  • Lower disposal costs and a predictable operation
  • Compliance with environmental regulations in Brazil and Paraguay
